question:

(MTS Non Tech Havaldar CBIC and CBN Examination 2024 )
options: strife
Power
Speed
Frailty
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Power

Energy - Power

Explanation:
"Power" is the correct synonym for "Energy" because both words refer to the capacity to do work or produce an effect.
ऊर्जा और शक्ति दोनों शब्द कार्य करने या प्रभाव उत्पन्न करने की क्षमता को दर्शाते हैं।

Other synonyms Words:
vigor, strength, force, vitality, dynamism

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Energy – ऊर्जा – The capacity to do work or produce an effect.
Example: "Renewable energy sources like solar and wind are sustainable."

Strife – संघर्ष – Angry or bitter disagreement over fundamental issues.
Example: "The political strife led to widespread unrest."

Speed – गति – The rate at which someone or something moves.
Example: "The car accelerated to a high speed on the highway."

Frailty – कमज़ोरी – The condition of being weak and delicate.
Example: "Old age often brings frailty and health issues."

Power – शक्ति – The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way.
Example: "The engine has enough power to pull heavy loads."

Conclusion:
"Power" is the best synonym for "Energy" as both denote the ability to perform work or exert force, whereas the other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.

The hot sun enervated the labourer to the extent that he collapsed.
(Combined Graduate Level Examination Tier I 2023)
options: weaken
elevate
energise
alleviate
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: weaken

enervated - weaken

Explanation:
The word "enervated" means to drain energy or weaken someone. In the given sentence, the hot sun weakened the laborer, causing him to collapse.
"enervated" का अर्थ है किसी की ऊर्जा को कम करना या कमजोर करना। दिए गए वाक्य में, तेज धूप ने मजदूर को कमजोर कर दिया, जिससे वह गिर पड़ा।

Other synonyms Words:
debilitate, exhaust, fatigue, sap, drain

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

enervated – कमजोर करना – (to weaken or drain energy)
Example: "The long journey enervated him completely."

elevate – ऊपर उठाना – (to raise or lift higher)
Example: "The promotion elevated his status in the company."

energise – ऊर्जा देना – (to give energy or vitality)
Example: "A good breakfast energises you for the day."

alleviate – कम करना – (to reduce pain or suffering)
Example: "The medicine helped alleviate his headache."

weaken – कमजोर करना – (to reduce strength or energy)
Example: "Lack of sleep can weaken your immune system."

Conclusion:
Among the given options, "weaken" is the best synonym for "enervated" because both words imply a reduction in strength or energy. The other options either mean the opposite (elevate, energise) or refer to reducing pain (alleviate), which does not fit the context.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Enforce
(Grade C Stenographers LDC Examination 2023 and 2024)
options: Oppress
Demoralise
Implement
Abolish
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Implement

Enforce - Implement

Explanation:
"Enforce" means to ensure compliance with rules or laws, and "Implement" means to put a decision or plan into effect, which aligns closely in meaning.
"Enforce" का अर्थ है नियमों या कानूनों का पालन सुनिश्चित करना, और "Implement" का अर्थ है किसी निर्णय या योजना को लागू करना, जो अर्थ में निकटता से जुड़ा है।

Other synonyms Words:
Apply, Execute, Administer, Impose, Carry out

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Enforce – लागू करना – To compel observance of or compliance with a law, rule, or obligation.
Example: "The police were called to enforce the new traffic regulations."

Oppress – अत्याचार करना – To keep someone in hardship by unjust authority or control.
Example: "The dictator used his power to oppress the citizens."

Demoralise – हतोत्साहित करना – To weaken the confidence or spirit of someone.
Example: "The team's repeated losses began to demoralise the players."

Abolish – समाप्त करना – To formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution.
Example: "The government decided to abolish the outdated tax law."

Implement – लागू करना – To put a decision, plan, or agreement into effect.
Example: "The company will implement new policies next month."

Conclusion:
"Implement" is the best synonym for "Enforce" because both involve putting rules or plans into action, whereas the other options either convey negative control (Oppress, Demoralise) or ending something (Abolish).

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Engross
(Grade C Stenographers LDC Examination 2023 and 2024)
options: Absorb
Contain
Attract
Distract
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Absorb

Engross - Absorb

Explanation:
"Engross" means to completely occupy the mind or attention, which is synonymous with "absorb," meaning to take in or soak up attention or interest.
"Engross" का अर्थ है पूरी तरह से मन या ध्यान को व्यस्त रखना, जो "absorb" का पर्याय है, जिसका अर्थ है ध्यान या रुचि को लेना या सोख लेना।

Other synonyms Words:
captivate, immerse, engage, occupy, fascinate

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Engross – मग्न करना – To occupy completely the mind or attention.
Example: "The novel was so interesting that it completely engrossed her."

Contain – समाहित करना – To hold or include within limits.
Example: "The box contains all the necessary tools."

Attract – आकर्षित करना – To draw attention or interest.
Example: "The bright colors attract customers to the store."

Distract – ध्यान भटकाना – To divert attention away.
Example: "Loud noises can distract students during exams."

Absorb – तल्लीन करना – To take in or soak up attention or interest.
Example: "The lecture was so engaging that it absorbed everyone’s attention."

Conclusion:
"Absorb" is the best synonym for "engross" because both words imply deep mental engagement or complete attention. The other options either mean holding something ("contain"), drawing interest ("attract"), or diverting attention ("distract"), which do not fully match the meaning of "engross."

options: involving
rancid
malodorous
musty
solution:

[engrossing] - involving

Explanation:
The word "engrossing" means something that captures full attention or is deeply interesting. "Involving" is the correct synonym as it also means engaging or absorbing.
(व्यस्त करने वाला – कुछ ऐसा जो पूरा ध्यान खींच ले या गहराई से दिलचस्प हो। "Involving" सही समानार्थी है क्योंकि यह भी आकर्षक या मनोरंजक होने का भाव देता है।)

Other synonyms Words:
absorbing, captivating, fascinating, riveting, gripping

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

[engrossing] – मनोरंजक – (deeply interesting, holding attention)
Example: "The movie was so engrossing that I forgot about time."

[rancid] – बासी – (having a stale or unpleasant smell or taste)
Example: "The butter had turned rancid due to prolonged exposure to heat."

[malodorous] – दुर्गंधयुक्त – (having a bad smell)
Example: "The malodorous garbage made the entire street unpleasant."

[musty] – बासी गंध वाला – (having a stale, damp, or moldy smell)
Example: "The old books had a musty odor from years of storage."

[involving] – रोचक – (engaging or absorbing attention)
Example: "The detective novel was so involving that I finished it in one sitting."

Conclusion:
Among the given options, "involving" is the best synonym for "engrossing" because both words describe something that deeply captures attention and interest. The other options relate to unpleasant smells and are irrelevant in this context.

The fire fighters enjoined the onlookers to stand clear.

enjoined - Advised

Let – अनुमति दी – To allow or permit.
Example: "His parents let him go to the party."

Advised – सलाह दी – To offer suggestions or recommendations.

solution:

"Entail" means to involve something as a necessary part or consequence, which aligns closely with "necessitate," meaning to make something necessary.
"Entail" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को एक आवश्यक भाग या परिणाम के रूप में शामिल करना, जो "necessitate" के अर्थ (किसी चीज़ को आवश्यक बनाना) से मेल खाता है।

Example: "The team worked hard to eliminate errors from the report."

Assume – मान लेना – To accept something as true without proof.
Example: "Don’t assume that everyone knows the rules."

Necessitate – आवश्यक बनाना – To make something necessary.
Example: "The sudden rain necessitated a change in our plans."

Conclusion:
"Necessitate" is the best synonym for "entail" because both words convey the idea of making something necessary or unavoidable. The other options do not fit the context.

question:

Equivalent
(Group D posts)
options: Mismatched
Different
Identical
Opposite
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Identical

Equivalent - Identical

Explanation:
"Equivalent" means equal in value, amount, function, or meaning, and "Identical" means exactly the same, making it the closest synonym.
समानार्थी: "Equivalent" का अर्थ है मूल्य, मात्रा, कार्य या अर्थ में बराबर, और "Identical" का अर्थ है बिल्कुल समान, जो इसे सबसे करीबी समानार्थी बनाता है।

Other synonyms Words:
Equal, Comparable, Corresponding, Similar, Alike

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Equivalent – समतुल्य – (Equal in value, amount, or meaning)
Example: "One dollar is roughly equivalent to 80 rupees."

Mismatched – बेमेल – (Not corresponding or fitting together)
Example: "His socks were mismatched, one blue and one black."

Different – अलग – (Not the same as another or each other)
Example: "The two paintings are completely different in style."

Opposite – विपरीत – (Completely different or contrary)
Example: "Black is the opposite of white."

Identical – एक समान – (Exactly the same)
Example: "The twins wore identical dresses to the party."

Conclusion:
"Identical" is the best synonym for "Equivalent" because both imply sameness in nature or value, whereas the other options suggest contrast or dissimilarity.
